verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents animating avatars that sync lip movements to your script (Photo Avatars), with control over avatar and voice and cinematic scenes built on avatar speech. It also documents AI dubbing with lip sync, and a hands-on community report praised the quality of a lip-synced dub. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of lip-syncing to user-uploaded audio (as opposed to a script), evidence of multi-character dialogue scenes, and independent corroboration of avatar lip-sync beyond the dubbing use case.
